summary: Ethan Allen Interiors filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, disclosing a formal, board-led CEO succession process for long-tenured Chairman/President/CEO M. Farooq Kathwari, whose employment agreement ends June 30, 2027. The independent Corporate Governance, Nominations and Sustainability Committee has retained a national executive search firm to evaluate internal and external candidates, with a public announcement committed no later than June 30, 2027; Kathwari will remain a non-executive director until the 2027 annual meeting. No price, stake, premium or transaction terms are stated. Watch for successor identity, strategic direction, and potential value-unlock catalysts around the leadership handoff.
